meta.title: Traumatic Brain Injury | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Supporting recovery of cognitive, physical and functional abilities after injury.

overview: Traumatic brain injury can follow a road accident, fall or sports incident, and its effects often reach well beyond the initial event, impacting memory, mobility, speech, behaviour and emotional well-being.

At Cambridge Hospital, our neurorehabilitation team delivers a structured Traumatic Brain Injury rehabilitation care plan combining physiotherapy, occupational therapy, and speech and language therapy.

Every care plan is tailored to the individual and reviewed throughout recovery as needs and goals change. From the early stages following hospital discharge through to returning to everyday life and the community, our team provides coordinated support across inpatient, outpatient and home care - helping each patient regain as much independence and function as possible.
